name: s3:GetObject on the bare glob '**' (any resource) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn iteration 5 regression, NON-arn glob class. '**' is two any-run wildcards - it matches EVERY resource string, exactly as broad as '*', but is spelled differently so the old code (which special-cased only the single bare '*' and otherwise required an 'arn:' prefix) read it as NOT broad -> findings=[] exit 0 CLEAN (DATA-EXFIL fail-open, T8). Semantic probe matching flags it: '**' matches probes across >=2 distinct accounts. GetObject is a read verb, so WILDCARD-RESOURCE must NOT fire.
